column1: 23242§obscene§əbˈsiːn§adj. 淫秽的，下流的；可憎的，可恶的；（数量）大得惊人的，骇人听闻的§The obscene words in the television programs were bleeped out.§电视节目中的粗鄙词语已用哔声消除了。
23243§authentic§ɔːˈθentɪk§adj. 真品的，真迹的；真正的，真实的，逼真的§Scientists have derived authentic data about the age of the skeleton from carbon dating tests.§科学家利用碳定年法得出了这具骨架的准确年代。
23244§righteous§ˈraɪtʃəs§adj. 正义的，正直的；公正的；正当的§No matter how good and righteous one thinks his action is, he shouldn't break the law.§不管一个人认为他的行为多么友善多么正义，他都不应该犯法。
23245§purify§ˈpjʊərɪfaɪ§vt. 使洁净，使纯洁，净化；提纯，精炼§As is well-known, one of the main doctrines of this religion is that people should try to purify their mind.§众所周知，该宗教的一条主要教义是人们要净化自己的心灵。
23246§gregarious§grɪˈgeəriəs§adj. 群居的；合群的；爱交际的§Dr. Green, a famous zoologist at the Harvard University, claimed that wild goose remains gregarious during the migration.§哈佛大学著名的动物学家格林博士称，大雁在迁徙中保持群居。
23247§heartless§ˈhɑːtləs§adj. 无情的，狠心的；无生气的，没精打采的§In employees' mind, employers are cold and heartless, showing no concern for their welfare.§在员工的心目中，雇主冷酷无情，不关心他们的福利。
23248§instill§ɪnˈstɪl§vt. 滴注；逐渐灌输；逐步培养（感受、思想等）§Trust and encouragement can instill confidence into a person, which can serve him or her well for life.§信任和鼓励能使人逐步树立起信心，让他们终生受益。
23249§infringe§ɪnˈfrɪndʒ§v. 侵犯，侵害；违背，触犯（法规）；干涉，干扰§Some students argued that the new school rule would infringe on their right to read in the morning.§一些学生争论说，这条新校规将侵犯他们晨读的权利。
23250§comic§ˈkɒmɪk§adj. 可笑的，滑稽的；喜剧的 n. 喜剧演员§Henry's accident of slipping on the banana skin brought some comic relief to this boring performance.§亨利意外踩到香蕉皮滑倒给这场沉闷的表演带来了些许喜剧色彩，缓和了氛围。

23251§transplant§trænsˈplɑːnt§vt. 移栽，移种（植物等）；移植（器官等）；使迁移，使移居[ˈtrænsplɑːnt] n. （器官等的）移植§Every year, tens of thousands of patients are given organ transplants in developed countries.§发达国家每年有数以万计的病人接受器官移植。
23252§spur§spɜː(r)§n. 刺激（物）；激励；靴刺，马刺 vt. 刺激，激励，鞭策；（用马刺）策马加速§Whenever the official holidays approach, many supermarkets spur the sales by means of promotion.§每当法定假日临近，许多超市就通过促销活动来刺激销售。
23253§barbaric§bɑːˈbærɪk§adj. 野蛮的，粗鲁的；残暴的，残忍的；原始部落的§The animal protectors consider the idea of killing wild animals for pleasure extremely barbaric.§动物保护者认为以猎杀野生动物为乐的想法极其野蛮。

23254§delinquent§dɪˈlɪŋkwənt§adj. 失职的；违法的；拖欠债务的 n. 违法者，罪犯（尤指少年犯）§A recent research shows that there has been a sharp increase in the rate of juvenile delinquent related to domestic violence.§最近的一项调查显示，与家庭暴力相关的青少年犯罪率剧增。
23255§sluttish§ˈslʌtɪʃ§adj. 懒惰的，邋遢的；放荡的§§

23256§retaliate§rɪˈtælieɪt§vi. 报复，反击；复仇§If you look down on people and treat them badly, they'll retaliate and appear just as annoying and hostile as you expected.§如果你瞧不起别人，待他们不好，他们就会回敬你，就会像你预料的那样显得令人讨厌，充满敌意。

23257§perpetrate§ˈpɜːpətreɪt§vt. 做（坏事），犯（罪）§Nowadays, there is a common phenomenon in society that more and more criminals make use of new scientific technologies to perpetrate crimes.§如今，社会上出现一个普遍的现象，越来越多的犯罪分子利用新的科学技术从事犯罪活动。
23258§prosper§ˈprɒspə(r)§vi. 繁荣，兴旺；成功§In other words, without languages, there will be no knowledge on which a society relies to prosper.§换句话说，没有语言，就没有一个社会赖以生存的知识。

23259§anchor§ˈæŋkə(r)§n. 锚；给人安全感的人（或物）；精神支柱；顶梁柱 v. 抛锚；使固定，系牢；使基于；主持（电视节目等）§When a ship anchors, it means sailors can stay in the town for a short time to live as locals.§轮船抛锚，意味着船员们可以在小镇稍作停留，过一下当地人的生活。
23260§despoil§dɪˈspɔɪl§vt. 抢夺，掠夺；蹂躏，破坏§If human beings continue to despoil the natural resources crazily, they will be doomed to be punished by nature.§如果人类继续疯狂地掠夺自然资源，他们必将遭到自然的惩罚。
23261§discourteous§dɪsˈkɜːtiəs§adj. 无礼的，粗鲁的§It would be discourteous for young people to ignore their parents' basic request for living together.§年轻人无视父母要求住在一起的基本请求是无礼的。
23262§lax§læks§adj. 懒散的；松弛的，不严格的，马虎的§Much to our surprise, some companies have been lax in carrying out their social responsibilities.§令我们大为吃惊的是，一些公司在履行其社会职责方面表现得很懈怠。

23263§boost§buːst§vt. 使增长，提高；使兴旺；鼓励，促进；为…作宣传，宣扬 n.增加，提高；帮助，激励§Apparently, stock prices were boosted by the President's recovery report and supportive policies from the government.§显而易见，股票价格随着总统的经济复苏报告和政府的扶持政策而一路上扬。

23264§smear§smɪə(r)§v. 胡乱涂抹；弄脏，弄污；诽谤，诋毁；变得模糊不清，把（图画等）弄得模糊不清n. 污迹，污渍；（显微镜的）涂片；诽谤，诋毁§Tony explained to the police that, the blood which was smeared on the front of his car belonged to a wild cat.§托尼向警方解释说，他车头蹭到的血迹是一只野猫的。

23265§lenient§ˈliːniənt§adj. （执法时）宽大的，宽容的；厚道的，仁慈的§According to the recent survey, most of the job applicants prefer to work at companies whose rules and regulations are lenient.§最新调查显示，大多数求职者喜欢在规章制度宽松的公司工作。
23266§synthetic§sɪnˈθetɪk§adj. 人造的；合成的，综合的 n. 合成物；合成纤维（织物）§Some clothes in the market including natural fibre silk and synthetic ones could not be crushed easily.§市面上一些含天然纤维真丝和合成纤维的衣服不易起皱。
23267§enact§ɪˈnækt§v. 通过（法律）；扮演（角色）§Under the new law, Internet bars must enact relevant policies to prevent young people's admission.§新的法律规定，网吧必须制定相关政策制止未成年人进入。

23268§resent§rɪˈzent§v. 愤恨；对…表示愤恨，感到气愤§With other audiences you mustn't attempt to cut in with humour as they will resent an outsider making disparaging remarks about their canteen or their chairman.§对于其他听众，你不能试图用幽默来打断他们的谈话，因为他们会讨厌一个外人对他们的餐厅或董事长发表轻蔑的评论。

23269§affluent§ˈæfluənt§adj. 丰富的，富裕的§Affluent someone may be born, but he is usually uncertain of how to create an admiring life with it or cherish all he has.§有些人可能生于富裕之家，但却往往不知道如何利用其先天优势来创造一个令人称羡的生活或是珍惜所拥有的一切。
23270§trunk§trʌŋk§n. 树干，躯干；大箱子；象鼻§White poplar is always eulogized by writers for its tall and straight trunk.§白杨树总因其高大笔直的枝干备受作家们的赞美。
23271§coexist§ˌkəʊɪgˈzɪst§vi. 共存，并存§Many foreigners believe that traditional Chinese medicine cannot coexist with western medicine in the west.§许多外国人认为，在西方，传统的中医很难与西医共存。
23272§aviation§ˌeɪviˈeɪʃn§n. 航空；飞行；航空制造业§It can be seen that Yang Liwei's travel in outer space around the earth's orbit is a milestone of China's aviation.§杨利伟在外太空绕地球轨道航行可以说是中国航天史上的一座里程碑。
23273§rampant§ˈræmpənt§adj. （犯罪、疾病等）猖獗的，肆虐的，泛滥的；（植物）蔓生的，疯长的§If one day inflation is rampant, it means that people's increased wage will be worth nothing soon.§如果有一天通货膨胀泛滥成灾，那就意味着人们增长的工资很快就会一文不值。
23274§prolonged§prəˈlɒŋd§adj. 持久的，长期的§As the recent experiment shows, prolonged use of the new drug might have harmful side effects on patients.§最新的实验表明，长期使用这种新药物可能会对病人产生有害的副作用。
23275§crushing§ˈkrʌʃɪŋ§adj. 惨重的，毁灭性的；压倒的，决定性的§The shipyard has been dealt another crushing blow with the failure to win this contract.§由于未能赢得这份合同，造船厂又遭到了一次惨重的打击。
23276§futile§ˈfjuːtaɪl§adj. 无效的，无用的，无意义的；（人）没出息的；琐细的§Our attempts to improve performance are futile.§我们为提高业绩而进行的努力都付诸东流了。
23277§edify§ˈedɪfaɪ§v. 陶冶，教化；启发，启迪§Good books not only edify but also entertain their readers.§好书不仅可以陶冶读者的情操，还可以娱乐读者。
23278§vulgar§ˈvʌlgə(r)§adj. 庸俗的，粗俗的；粗鲁的，缺乏教养的§It seems pretty vulgar to give a woman your business card in public asking for a date or dinner.§当众给女性名片要求约会或共进晚餐似乎非常粗俗。
23279§core§kɔː(r)§n. 果心，果核；（物体的）中心部分；核心，要点，精髓 vt.去掉核§Any profit company's core is trying to transform its product into capital.§任何营利性公司的核心都是要将其产品转化为资本。
23280§inborn§ˌɪnˈbɔːn§adj. 天生的，先天的，天赋的§Many sociologists claim good living habits are not inborn but can be learned by hard-working.§许多社会学家声称，好的生活习惯不是天生的，而是可以通过努力习得的。
23281§habitable§ˈhæbɪtəbl§adj. 适于居住的，可居住的§Some areas of the earth are not habitable because of extreme climate conditions, such as low temperature.§地球上的一些区域由于低温之类的极端气候条件而不适合人类居住。

23282§ecological§ˌiːkəˈlɒdʒɪkl§adj. 生态学的，生态的§Some scientists claim that the destruction of the rainforests is an ecological disaster that is threatening the survival of life on earth.§一些科学家声称，雨林的破坏是一场生态灾难，正威胁着地球上生命的生存。
23283§stipulate§ˈstɪpjuleɪt§v. 规定，明确要求；（作为条件）讲定，约定§The new regulation stipulates that every procedure has to comply to the relevant safety production standards.§新制度规定每一个步骤都要遵守相关的安全生产标准。

23284§legitimize§lɪˈdʒɪtəmaɪz§vt. 使合法；赋予合法权利§Some parents are concerned that a lot of violent films will be legitimized, which will pose a threat to their children's mental health.§一些家长担心，大量的暴力电影被合法化会对孩子的心理健康构成威胁。
23285§crystallize§ˈkrɪstəlaɪz§v. （使）结晶；（使）变明确§Sometimes, what we suffered in life is not a totally mess, which might help us to crystallize pieces of thoughts.§我们生活中所遭遇的并不一定完全是坏事，有时也可以帮我们总结出一些想法。
23286§solar-powered§ˈsəʊlə ˌpaʊəd§adj. 由太阳能驱动的§Solar-powered battery can transform the energy of sunlight into electric energy.§太阳能电池能把光能转化为电能。
23287§cosy§ˈkəʊzi§adj. 舒适的，安逸的§Learning in a warm and cosy classroom is the best dream these children in impoverished mountainous district have wished.§能够在温暖舒适的教室里学习是贫困山区孩子们最大的愿望。
23288§roller§ˈrəʊlə(r)§n. 滚筒；滚轴§The huge roller can press melted metal into thin sheet which is the raw material of knife.§大型滚筒可以将熔化的金属压成薄片，作为刀具的原材料。

23289§unsanitary§ʌnˈsænətri§adj. 不卫生的 （=insanitary）§Lack of access to safe water, poor housing, and unsanitary conditions all have a strong bearing on the health of the mother and child.§缺乏安全用水、住房条件差以及不卫生的环境都对母亲和儿童的健康有很大的影响。
23290§condone§kənˈdəʊn§v. 宽恕，赦免；纵容，容忍§If the government condones violent conflict between the two parties, the bloodshed will never stop.§如果政府无视两党之间的暴力冲突，流血事件将永远不会停止。
23291§bereave§bɪˈriːv§vt. 使丧失，剥夺§Nobody can bereave wild animals and plants of their survival on the blue planet where we live together.§没人能够剥夺野生动植物在我们共有的蓝色星球上生存的权利。
23292§faulty§ˈfɔːlti§adj. 有错误的，有缺点的；不完美的§In addition to faulty brake, this terrible accident which has caused 3 dead and 1 injured, was attributed to drunk driving.§除了刹车有问题之外，酒后驾车也是导致这起三死一伤严重事故的原因。
23293§enigma§ɪˈnɪgmə§n. 谜，谜一样的人或事§Up to now, researchers and scientists cannot explain the whole enigma of Mayan civilization's disappearance.§研究者和科学家至今都无法解释玛雅文明消失这个谜团。
23294§spare§speə(r)§adj. 闲置的；备用的，外加的；空闲的 v. 省出，抽出（时间等）；饶恕，赦免；免去；不吝惜（时间、金钱等） n. 备用品；[pl.] 配件§Thank you very much for sparing so much of your time to talk with me.§非常感谢您抽出这么长的时间与我谈话。
23295§nursery§ˈnɜːsəri§adj. 幼儿教育的 n. 托儿所；苗圃§Whether the state should provide free nursery education or not is being discussed on the table.§国家是否应该提供免费的幼儿教育这一问题正在讨论之中。
23296§semantic§sɪˈmæntɪk§adj. 语义的§It is well-known that the professor is expert in language teaching and semantic analysis.§众所周知，该教授擅长语言教学和语义分析。
23297§barren§ˈbærən§adj. （土地等）贫瘠的，荒芜的；不结果实的，不育的；无益的，无效果的§Geographers made great efforts to find that millions of years ago the region was a barren desert.§地理学家经过极大的努力发现，数百万年前该地区是一片荒芜的沙漠。

23298§conductive§kənˈdʌktɪv§adj. 能传导电（或热）的，导电（或热）的§Scientists found that this kind of new material was more conductive at extremely low temperature than at the ordinary temperature.§科学家发现，这种新材料在极端的低温条件下比在常温下导电性更好。

23299§eccentric§ɪkˈsentrɪk§adj. 古怪的，反常的 n. 古怪的人§Psychologists are trying to find the reason why some children cultivate eccentric behaviour to separate themselves from their peers.§心理学家正致力于为一些孩子远离同伴孤立自己的古怪行为找出原因。
23300§inferior§ɪnˈfɪəriə(r)§adj. 较差的，次的，低劣的；级别低的，较低的 n. 下级；下属，晚辈§In general, schooling in suburbs is inferior to that in downtown, interior regions to coastal ones.§一般而言，城郊的学校教育不如市中心的，内陆的不如沿海的。
23301§slacken§ˈslækən§v. （使）松弛，放松；放慢；萧条§The pace of export and import slackened during the last quarter due to trade barrier between the two countries.§由于两国间的贸易壁垒，进出口步伐在上一季度有所放缓。
23302§mentor§ˈmentɔː(r)§n. 导师；顾问，指导者§Every great leader who has created great achievement has a mentor, who can advise, help and point him to success.§每一个创造了巨大成就的伟大领袖都有一个能够给他建议、帮助他并指引他走向成功的导师。
23303§pad§pæd§n. 软垫；便笺本 v. （用软材料）填塞；蹑手蹑脚地走§Secretary always puts a pad by the telephone for taking notes.§秘书总是在电话机旁放一个便笺本以便做记录。

23304§unblemished§ʌnˈblemɪʃt§adj. 无瑕疵的，完好的§Some states indicated that, it would be legal to get a remission if a prisoner in jail keeps an unblemished record in three years.§一些州政府表示，如果服刑期的囚犯三年内没有任何不良记录，就可以合法获得减刑。
23305§lounge§laʊndʒ§vi. 懒洋洋地站（或坐、躺） n. 等候室；休息室§Some students were used to lounging in the dormitory to surf on the Internet at the weekends.§一些学生习惯于周末待在宿舍，懒洋洋地坐着，在网上冲浪。
23306§dietary§ˈdaɪətəri§adj. 饮食的§For tourists with special dietary requirements, we will offer a variety of delicious food for them to choose.§对于有特殊饮食要求的游客，我们会提供各种美食供其选择。
23307§hamper§ˈhæmpə(r)§vt. 妨碍，阻挠 n. 有盖的大篮子；盒装食物§Fierce storms have been hampering rescue work and there is now little chance of finding more survivors.§猛烈的暴风雨阻碍了救援工作，现在找到更多幸存者的机会已经很小了。

23308§disparage§dɪˈspærɪdʒ§vt. 贬低，贬抑；轻蔑，轻视§The charitable work, which public figures, especially actors and singers have done, has been disparaged by the press as an attempt to get publicity.§公众人物，尤其是演员和歌手，所做的慈善工作被媒体贬抑为自我宣传。

23309§corporal§ˈkɔːpərəl§adj. 肉体的，身体的 n. （陆军或空军）下士§Some claim that teachers have no rights to treat naughty students with corporal punishment, while others hold an opposite opinion.§一些人声称教师无权体罚顽皮的学生，而另一些人持相反观点。

23310§libel§ˈlaɪbl§n. （文字）诽谤，中伤；诽谤性文字 vt. 诽谤，中伤，诬蔑§Recently, that movie star is determined to sue the mass media for their libels, while he chose to keep silent in the past.§最近，那位电影明星决定指控大众媒体损害其名誉，而在过去他选择保持沉默。
23311§criterion§kraɪˈtɪəriən§n. 标准，准则§Success in studying at school is not an appropriate criterion of achievement in life.§在学校里学习好并不是衡量人生成就的一个恰当的标准。
23312§eco-friendly§ˌiːkəʊ ˈfrendli§adj. 环保的§Reusable bag is an eco-friendly product which was famous for its slogan “I am not a plastic bag!”§可再利用袋是一种环保产品，它曾以“我不是塑料袋”的标语而闻名。
